text.p: Net Income Per Share of Common Stock .93 .84

Net Income Per Share of Common Stock 1.81 1.72
(a) Amounts are net of applicable income tax

NOTE: Q2 property and casualty operations had a $24 million underwriting profit compared with a $4.4 million last year. Co said improvement came primarily from homeowners line, which posted Q2 $4.4 million underwriting loss compared to $19 million underwriting loss last year.

SAFECO's largest line, personal auto, and surety and commercial lines also contributed to property and casualty's Q2 earnings. Property and casualty pretax income, including dividends and interest, was $93 million compared with $74 million for the same period last year.
Life and health operations Q2 pretax profit was $35.7 million compared with $37.3 million last year.
The real estate, credit and asset management operations Q2 profits $2.8 million, $5.3 million and $1.4 million, respectively.
